sentences.en: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
sentences.zh: 我们必须对这起事故进行仔细分析。

sentences.en: In the last analysis, methods don't educate children; people do.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，是人而不是方法在教育孩子。

sentences.en: Let us begin our analysis by positing the following question.
sentences.zh: 让我们先提出一个问题开始我们的分析吧。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ana（类似）+lys（分解）+ is（表情况）→类似分解→分析
